proposal_text: 01 Purpose Feedback left in a Hero Campaign Pack run sheet is currently saved as notes for the team. It does not change the asset. To get a better version, someone has to rewrite it by hand or re-run the whole film, and a re-run starts from scratch without the notes. The objective is to let the 776BC team refine each asset from their own feedback, inside the Workbench, and review the result in the same pack. I recommend adding a Revise with feedback function to the run sheet. You write your notes on an asset, select Revise, and a new version of that asset is returned to the pack for you to compare and approve. Recommended decision Approve the six-hour Workbench Feedback Loop build. Engagement parameters PlatformWorkbenchHero Campaign Pack Effort6 hours Delivery1 weekfrom approval Fixed feeA$2,400ex GST 02 How it works The loop runs from your notes to a revised asset in the same pack. You remain the reviewer at every turn. Leave feedbackRecord what to keep, what to change and how close the asset is, as you do today. Select ReviseChoose Revise with feedback on that asset. One asset is rewrittenThe Workbench redrafts only that asset from your notes, the original film and transcript, and the 776BC brand rules. The film is not re-run. The pack updatesThe asset is marked as revised and ready to review on its Workbench card. Compare and decideCompare the previous and revised versions, then approve it or leave further feedback and revise again. Today Notes are saved and visible to the team The asset does not change A better version needs a manual rewrite or a full re-run With the feedback loop Notes become the brief for the next version Only the selected asset is redrafted A revision is expected to take minutes, not the length of a full run 03 How it is delivered The work starts with a test on a real 776BC pack, so the quality of revisions is proven before the function is built around it. StepOutcomeHours Test on a recent packOne or two assets from a recent Hero Campaign Pack revised from your saved feedback, with the previous and revised versions shared for your review.1.5 Build and releaseThe Revise with feedback function in the run sheet, the revision process, version comparison and the revised status on the Workbench card.3.5 Try it togetherUse on live 776BC work, with the revision instructions tuned to how the results read.1 Total6 hours Work will commence once the proposal is approved and the initial payment is received. Delivery is planned within one week of approval. 04 What you receive Revise with feedback for each written asset in a Hero Campaign Pack: landing page, EDM, Instagram caption, blog, brand LinkedIn, Kate LinkedIn and Cam LinkedIn Comparison of the previous and revised versions Previous versions retained Revised status on the Workbench card The function available to signed-in team members only A test on a recent pack before release Keeping revisions on-brand and accurate Revisions use the same 776BC voice and channel rules as the first draft Every statement must trace to the film transcript, and quotes must be exact. Nothing is invented about Kate, Cam or the product A revision that fails these checks is discarded and the current version stays unchanged Brand-wide feedback remains a proposal that an owner approves before it applies Human approval remains mandatory Each revision is a new draft for review. Nothing is approved or published automatically, and model outputs can vary between requests. 05 Not included Image revisions, such as choosing a different frame or generating a new still Revising every asset in a pack in one action Revising the alternative story directions Workflows other than the Hero Campaign Pack Changes to the 776BC brand canon AI usage costs on 776BC's existing OpenAI and Anthropic accounts, indicatively cents to tens of cents per revision Ongoing support beyond the included session Image revisions and whole-pack revisions are natural next phases. Each would be scoped separately before work begins. 06 Investment and terms Fixed project fee A$2,400 excluding GST The fee covers six hours of testing, development, release and the included session with the team. Payment terms 50% on approval and commencement 50% on release to the 776BC team Additional work requires prior written approval Approved additional work is billed at A$400 per hour excluding GST This proposal is valid for 14 days. Intellectual property 776BC retains ownership of its brand material, content and confidential business information. Following full payment, the feedback loop forms part of 776BC's Workbench. OptiFlows retains ownership of its pre-existing and reusable methods, frameworks, implementation techniques and general know-how.
